prompt: An open task never appears among work the agent can claim. Determine how to inspect why it is not ready and what dependency semantics matter.

A Dolt pull reports conflicting issue state between clones. Diagnose, safely reconcile, verify, and publish the repaired tracker state.
Beads reports persistent database lock or integrity errors and issue state looks inconsistent. Recover without deleting internal Dolt files or destroying the only good copy.
Turn a repeatable multi-step engineering process into a reusable template and instantiate it as live dependency-ordered work for agents.
Connect two related beads for knowledge navigation without making either bead block the other. Choose the appropriate relationship semantics.
Several Git worktrees should operate on the same tracker state. Explain which Beads workspace they use and how cross-clone state moves.
Configure Codex so Beads context survives session startup and is refreshed after context compaction instead of silently disappearing.
